name: Onu is meditating
summary: At the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore, Onu enters a deep trance as a threat grows. The ancient of lore weighs the alliance and motives of the Twilight's Hammer cult and the naga. If you lose your scrying phial, speak to him for another.

sections.title: A Mind in Deep Contemplation
sections.body: In the Grove of the Ancients, Onu holds Kalimdor's history in his ancient memory. Ominous reports of dark excavations at the Master's Glaive draw his vast consciousness inward. He considers what brings the fanatical Twilight's Hammer cultists and the naga to the petrified remains of an ancient behemoth. As you carry out his reconnaissance, Onu remains within reach and can replace a scrying phial misplaced in the wild.

sections.title: Scrying the Depths
sections.body:
Onu uses nature-attuned divination to watch the ruins without risking his physical presence. He entrusts you with a scrying phial, which conjures a scrying bowl at the excavation site and lets him commune from afar. The journey south through Darkshore is perilous, with hostile wildlife and cultist patrols, so mishaps can happen.

Onu's trance is an attentive vigil, not unbroken slumber. He readily offers another vial of sacred waters so you can continue the investigation of the Master's Glaive.

faq.answer: Onu meditates over the disturbing presence of the Twilight's Hammer cult and the naga at the Master's Glaive. He seeks to perceive their motives and guide you as you investigate the site.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this interaction?
faq.answer: This interaction is a safety measure for adventurers at The Master's Glaive. If you lose your Phial of Scrying, speaking with Onu provides a replacement so you can complete the ritual.
Onu is rooted in the Grove of the Ancients in central-southern Darkshore, just off the main road.

faq.q: What do I do with the Phial of Scrying?
aliases: how to use phial of scrying
faq.answer: Carry the phial to the Master's Glaive and use it to create a scrying bowl. Onu can then communicate with you through the bowl.

The Master's Glaive is an ancient excavation site in southern Darkshore. There, the colossal petrified skull of a forgotten entity lies pierced by a gargantuan blade. Cultists and naga have gathered there for unknown, malevolent purposes.

faq.q: Can Horde players interact with Onu here?
faq.answer: Onu is allied strictly with the night elves and the Alliance. Horde adventurers near the Grove of the Ancients will find him and his protectors hostile or uncooperative.

angles.text: As a night elf, you revere ancients of lore like Onu, stewards of Kalimdor's balance. Their ageless wisdom helps you understand disturbances in Darkshore's wilds.
As a druid, you share a profound bond with nature and ancients of lore. Scrying rituals reflect the Cenarion Circle's way of surveying tainted ground from a distance.
As an Alliance traveler, securing Darkshore from cultists and aquatic invaders matters as you journey between Teldrassil and Ashenvale.
